measurement_note: Size N is both the array length n and query count q. Each query uses step N and therefore updates only its left endpoint. Tiers 32, 128, and 512 span 16x. Direct progression iteration is O(N); a correct dense range scan examines O(N) candidate indices for each of N queries and is O(N^2), must return every expected XOR, and must fail only scaling.
